description: Tool-neutral compile-and-serialize contract for ak.vector.sdk.event_type_axes.v1. Each case declares a language-neutral program fragment, the expected compile outcome and, where it compiles, the expected canonical serialization. A language adapter binds fragment_bindings to the exact published SDK artifact, compiles each fragment against it and executes the declared assertion. The verdict is only whether the fragment compiles and what a compiling fragment serializes to; a compiler's private diagnostic code or wording is never a protocol error code and MUST NOT be asserted.

axis_sources.outer_submission_types: spec/v1/artifacts/registry/contract-registry.json and the event-kind-registry.json it generates, plus the Event and RealmCommit schemas
axis_sources.payload_protection_types: the payload schemas referenced by event_kinds[].payload_schema_ref
axis_sources.rule: The adapter MUST read the axis values from these canonical contracts at build time. Transcribing a second event classification or axis enumeration into this fixture is non-conformant, which is why no case below hard-codes a kind list.

fragment_bindings.OuterEvent: the SDK's closed producer Event submission type
fragment_bindings.OuterRealmCommit: the SDK's closed authority RealmCommit type
fragment_bindings.PlainPayload: the SDK's plaintext payload-protection wrapper type
fragment_bindings.MlsEncryptedPayload: the SDK's MLS-encrypted payload-protection wrapper type
fragment_bindings.MlsProtocolPayload: a concrete MLS protocol payload type exposed by the SDK
fragment_bindings.submit: the SDK submission entry point that accepts only verified values
fragment_bindings.verify: the SDK verification constructor that turns wire bytes into a verified value
fragment_bindings.AnyDurableKind: any durable event kind read from the canonical registry at build time
fragment_bindings.AnyKindWhosePayloadIsMlsProtected: a durable kind whose registered payload schema is MLS protected
fragment_bindings.AnyKindWhosePayloadIsPlaintext: a durable kind whose registered payload schema is plaintext

expected.reason: producer Event and authority RealmCommit are distinct closed types with no implicit conversion
PlainPayload, MlsEncryptedPayload and the concrete MLS protocol payload types are distinct closed types
the kind's registered payload protection and the payload wrapper type disagree, and the disagreement is rejected at compile time rather than at admission
the second axis value is not admissible for this kind

cases.name: unverified_wire_bytes_cannot_reach_the_submission_entry_point
cases.fragment: submit(<raw wire bytes or a draft value that has not passed verify>);

expected.reason: submit accepts only the verified value type; there is no public constructor that produces it without verification

cases.name: a_verified_submission_cannot_be_mutated_in_place
cases.fragment: let verified = verify(<wire bytes>); verified.payload = <another payload>;

expected.reason: the public type and API surface expose no in-place mutation of a verified submission

cases.name: a_legal_combination_compiles_and_serializes_through_the_canonical_contract
cases.fragment: let verified = verify(<wire bytes of an OuterEvent carrying AnyKindWhosePayloadIsPlaintext with PlainPayload>); serialize(verified);

expected.serialization_contract: the same canonical schema and transcript the service uses for admission

cases.note: This positive case exists to exclude the false pass in which every fragment fails to compile because the adapter is misconfigured. A run whose compile-fail cases are red while this case does not compile is not a pass.

cases.name: a_legal_mls_protected_combination_compiles_and_serializes
cases.fragment: let verified = verify(<wire bytes of an OuterEvent carrying AnyKindWhosePayloadIsMlsProtected with MlsEncryptedPayload>); serialize(verified);

expected.serialization_contract: the same canonical schema and transcript the service uses for admission

cases.name: a_realm_commit_value_serializes_through_its_own_canonical_contract
cases.fragment: let verified = verify(<wire bytes of an OuterRealmCommit>); serialize(verified);

expected.serialization_contract: the RealmCommit canonical body with the signature removed for commit_id derivation, as the authority log defines it

runner_notes: A verifier maps ak.suite.sdk.event_type_axes.v1 to a local adapter; an unknown or unmapped suite id fails closed.
The adapter compiles each fragment against the exact published SDK artifact named in the conformance claim, not against a rebuilt or patched copy.

public_api_inventory remains the A-grade supplement for this clause with acceptable-set semantics; it is evidence that the mutation and bypass entry points are absent, not a substitute for having run the compile-fail cases.
